name: exec.which
description: Looks up one or more executable names in PATH without starting a process and returns whether any were found and their paths.

name.description: One executable name to find. Use names instead to check several.

names.description: Executable names to search for; found is true if any name exists.

path.description: Optional PATH value to search instead of the process PATH.

examples.program: run exec.which with name "execute" and path "" as result
